message:
The scheduled eval run on the dev machine did not publish the trend page — or did not run at all.

`agent_evals.scheduled_run.publish_ok` is written once per run by `agent-evals/scripts/scheduled_eval.sh` (daily 09:00 ET, weekly Monday 09:30 ET): 1 when `gh-pages` was read back at the commit just built, 0 otherwise.

- **Alert** = a run reported 0. Read `~/Library/Logs/agent-evals/daily.log` (or `weekly.log`): the PUBLISH FAILED line carries both hashes.
- **No data** for 36 h = no run reported at all: the laptop slept past a missed interval, launchd could not start the job (the 2026-09-07 exit 127 was a missing venv), or `DD_API_KEY` was absent from `~/.zshrc`.

The page: https://snacksnack.github.io/agent-evals/ — its masthead `generated` stamp is the render time. Fix the cause, run `scripts/scheduled_eval.sh daily` by hand; the next 1 clears this.

RC1-415 — before this monitor the 2026-09-08 PUBLISH FAILED line (a false alarm, as it turned out) was visible only in the log.

@hire.reid.collins@gmail.com
